test_freeze_mujoco_env: test that freezing a MuJoCo gym environment produces deterministic observations and rewards across steps
test_get_and_set_state: test that getting and setting environment state works correctly for MuJoCo gym environments
test_transfer_state: test that environment state can be transferred between two separate MuJoCo gym environment instances
run_freeze_test: run the freeze test on Hopper-v4 and Humanoid-v4 MuJoCo environments to verify deterministic behavior
run_state_tests: run state get/set and transfer tests on HalfCheetah-v4, Hopper-v4, and Humanoid-v4 environments
